description: Fill an existing open order on the CC/USDC book (taker action). If filling a SELL order: you buy CC and transfer USDC. If filling a BUY order: you sell CC and receive USDC. Partial fills supported.

fill_cogs.description: How many cogs to fill (optional — omit to fill entire order)

order_id.description: UUID of the order to fill (from get_cc_orderbook)

name: fill_cc_order
